verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs confirm on-reader tipping, where the card reader suggests tips to customers before collecting payment. They also confirm tips can be collected before or after authorization, including on-receipt tipping. The evidence never shows how a merchant configures the prompts. missing for 10: documented configuration of tip percentages, smart-amount thresholds, custom/manual tip entry, a Dashboard or API path for merchant-ops to set tipping options, independent or hands-on corroboration.
